title: Exactly K Distinct
statement:
Count nonempty subarrays with exactly k distinct values using two at-most-k sliding window counts.

Input
n k, then n signed integers.

Output
The number of qualifying subarrays.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. Array values have absolute value at most 10⁹. 1 ≤ k ≤ n.
